title: Ravana orders Hanuma to be killed
introduction: Hearing the harsh words of Hanuma, Ravana orders him to be killed. Vibhishana, however, advises Ravana to desist from the dastardly act, pointing out that the killing of an envoy is forbiddenaccording to religious scriptures.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 52nd Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वानरस्य महात्मनः |
आज्ञापयत् वधम् तस्य रावणः क्रोध मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā vānarasya mahātmanaḥ |
ājñāpayat vadham tasya rāvaṇaḥ krodha mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words of the high=souled Hanuma, Ravana duly excited with anger, ordered for the killing of Hanuma.

verses.devanagari:
वधे तस्य समाज्ञप्ते रावणेन दुरात्मना |
निवेदितवतो दौत्यम् न अनुमेने विभीषणः
verses.iast:
vadhe tasya samājñapte rāvaṇena durātmanā |
niveditavato dautyam na anumene vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: While it was ordered by the evil-natured Ravana for the killing of Hanuma, Vibhishana did not agree to the killing of Hanuma, who was entrusted with the functions of a messenger.

verses.devanagari:
तम् रक्षो अधिपतिम् क्रुद्धम् तच् च कार्यम् उपस्थितम् |
विदित्वा चिन्तयामास कार्यम् कार्य विधौ स्थितः
verses.iast:
tam rakṣo adhipatim kruddham tac ca kāryam upasthitam |
viditvā cintayāmāsa kāryam kārya vidhau sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Ravana getting enraged and looking to that affair (of killing of an envoy) that has arisen, Vibhishana who was firm in accompanying any object, reflected upon an appropriate action to be done.

glosses.meaning: the appropriate action to be done.

verses.devanagari:
निश्चित अर्थः ततः साम्ना आपूज्य शत्रुजित् अग्रजम् |
उवाच हितम् अत्यर्थम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
verses.iast:
niścita arthaḥ tataḥ sāmnā āpūjya śatrujit agrajam |
uvāca hitam atyartham vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Then, deciding about a right action, Vibhishna, who was silled in communication and a conqueror of enemies, spoke softly the following very meaningful and useful words to Ravana, his venerable borther.

verses.devanagari:
क्षमस्व रोषम् त्यज राक्षसेन्द्र |
प्रसीद मद्वाक्यमिदम् शृणुष्व |
वधम् न कुर्वन्ति परावरज्ञा |
दूतस्य सन्तो वसुधाधिपेन्द्राः
verses.iast:
kṣamasva roṣam tyaja rākṣasendra |
prasīda madvākyamidam śṛṇuṣva |
vadham na kurvanti parāvarajJṇā |
dūtasya santo vasudhādhipendrāḥ
verses.translation: "O king of demons! Forgive and give up your anger. Be gracious and hear my words. Virtuous kings of excellence, knowing the distant and the near, do not cause killing of an envoy."

glosses.meaning: knowing the disant and the near

verses.devanagari:
राजन् धर्म विरुद्धम् च लोक वृत्तेः च गर्हितम् |
तव च असदृशम् वीर कपेः अस्य प्रमापणम्
verses.iast:
rājan dharma viruddham ca loka vṛtteḥ ca garhitam |
tava ca asadṛśam vīra kapeḥ asya pramāpaṇam
verses.translation: "O hero! Killing of this monkey is against a royal virtue and any universal custom condemns it. Hence, it is improper for you also to do it."

glosses.meaning: is antagonistic to a royal virtue

verses.devanagari:
धर्मज्ञ्श्च कृतज्ञ्श्च राजधर्मविशारदः |
परावरज्ञो भूतानाम् त्वमेव परमार्थवित्
verses.iast:
dharmajJṇśca kṛtajJṇśca rājadharmaviśāradaḥ |
parāvarajJṇo bhūtānām tvameva paramārthavit
verses.translation: "You are indeed the knower of what is right. You are a person of gratitude. You are well-versed in royal virtues. You know both the distant and the near in beings. You know the highest truth."

glosses.meaning: the knower of what is right
you are experienced in royal virtues
you know both the distant and the near

verses.devanagari:
गृह्यन्ते यदि रोषेण त्वादृशोऽपि विपश्चितः |
ततः शास्त्रविपश्चित्त्वम् श्रम एव हि केवलम्
verses.iast:
gṛhyante yadi roṣeṇa tvādṛśo'pi vipaścitaḥ |
tataḥ śāstravipaścittvam śrama eva hi kevalam
verses.translation: "If even learned persons like you are seized by anger, then the knowledge of scriptures is indeed just a labour in vain."

glosses.meaning: is indeed just a labour in vain.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात्प्रसीद शत्रुघ्न राक्षसेन्द्र दुरासद |
ततः शास्त्रविपश्चित्त्वम् श्रम एव हि केवल्म्
verses.iast:
tasmātprasīda śatrughna rākṣasendra durāsada |
tataḥ śāstravipaścittvam śrama eva hi kevalm
verses.translation: "O king of demons! O annihilator of enemies, dangerous to be approached! Therefore, be graceful. After ascertaining about right and wrong, let appropriate punishment be ordered to the envoy."

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः |
रोषेण महताविष्टो वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
roṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo vākyamuttaramabravīt
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Vibhishana, Ravana the lord of demons was greatly enraged and replied in the following words:

glosses.meaning: was enveloped by a great anger

verses.devanagari:
न पापानाम् वधे पापम् विद्यते शत्रुसूदन |
तस्मादेनम् वधिष्यामि वानरम् पापचारिणम्
verses.iast:
na pāpānām vadhe pāpam vidyate śatrusūdana |
tasmādenam vadhiṣyāmi vānaram pāpacāriṇam
verses.translation: "O Vibhishana, the annihilator of enemies! There is no sin, even if the sinners are killed. So, I shall kill this monkey, who performed sins."

verses.devanagari:
अधर्ममूलम् बहुदोषयुक्त |
मनार्यजुष्टम् वचनम् निशम्य |
उवाच वाक्यम् परमार्थतत्त्वम् |
विभीषणो बुद्धिमताम् वरिष्ठः
verses.iast:
adharmamūlam bahudoṣayukta |
manāryajuṣṭam vacanam niśamya |
uvāca vākyam paramārthatattvam |
vibhīṣaṇo buddhimatām variṣṭhaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words, rooted in unrighteousness, enveloped in a great anger and accepted by the dishonourable, Vibhishana the best among those who weer endowed with understanding, spoke the following words, comprising of the highest truth.

glosses.meaning: the best buddhimataam = among those who were endowed iwht understanding

verses.devanagari:
प्रसीद लङ्केश्वर राक्षसेन्द्र |
धर्मार्थयुक्तम् वचनम् शृणुष्व |
दूतानवध्यान् समयेषु राजन् |
सर्वेषु सर्वत्र वदन्ति सन्तः
verses.iast:
prasīda laṇ^keśvara rākṣasendra |
dharmārthayuktam vacanam śṛṇuṣva |
dūtānavadhyān samayeṣu rājan |
sarveṣu sarvatra vadanti santaḥ
verses.translation: "O king of demons! O lord of Lanka! Be gracious enough. Hear my words endowed with righteousness and significance. O king! Sages say that messengers should not be killed at all places and at all times."

verses.devanagari:
असंशयम् शत्रुः अयम् प्रवृद्धः |
कृतम् हि अनेन अप्रियम् अप्रमेयम् |
न दूत वध्याम् प्रवदन्ति सन्तो |
दूतस्य दृष्टा बहवो हि दण्डाः
verses.iast:
asaṃśayam śatruḥ ayam pravṛddhaḥ |
kṛtam hi anena apriyam aprameyam |
na dūta vadhyām pravadanti santo |
dūtasya dṛṣṭā bahavo hi daṇḍāḥ
verses.translation: "There is no doubt that this enemy is arrogant. He has created an unlimited displeasure to us. But, sages do not talk about the killing of an envoy There are indeed severeal punishments, intended for an envoy."

glosses.meaning: about the killing of an envoy

verses.devanagari:
वैरूप्याम् अन्गेषु कश अभिघातो |
मौण्ड्यम् तथा लक्ष्मण सम्निपातः |
एतान् हि दूते प्रवदन्ति दण्डान् |
वधः तु दूतस्य न नः श्रुतो अपि
verses.iast:
vairūpyām angeṣu kaśa abhighāto |
mauṇḍyam tathā lakṣmaṇa samnipātaḥ |
etān hi dūte pravadanti daṇḍān |
vadhaḥ tu dūtasya na naḥ śruto api
verses.translation: "Some of the punishments to an envoy are-deforming the limbs, striking with a whip, shaving the head and impressing marks on the body. Indeed, we have not heard at any time of killing a messenger."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् च धर्म अर्थ विनीत बुद्धिः |
पर अवर प्रत्यय निश्चित अर्थः |
भवत् विधः कोप वशे हि तिष्ठेत् |
कोपम् नियच्छन्ति हि सत्त्ववन्तः
verses.iast:
katham ca dharma artha vinīta buddhiḥ |
para avara pratyaya niścita arthaḥ |
bhavat vidhaḥ kopa vaśe hi tiṣṭhet |
kopam niyacchanti hi sattvavantaḥ
verses.translation: "How can a person like you, holding an intellect trained in religious merit and purpose and a right judgement on cause and effect, subject to anger? Wise people indeed contain their anger."

glosses.meaning: holding an intellect trained in religious merit and purpose
and who has a right judgement over cause and effect

verses.devanagari:
न धर्म वादे न च लोक वृत्ते |
न शास्त्र बुद्धि ग्रहणेषु वा अपि |
विद्येत कश्चित् तव वीर तुल्यः |
त्वम् हि उत्तमः सर्व सुर असुराणाम्
verses.iast:
na dharma vāde na ca loka vṛtte |
na śāstra buddhi grahaṇeṣu vā api |
vidyeta kaścit tava vīra tulyaḥ |
tvam hi uttamaḥ sarva sura asurāṇām
verses.translation: "O hero! There is no one equal to you, who can discuss about the law or duty, none about universal custom and none in capturing the essence of scriptures. You are indeed excellent among all the celestials and demons in these matter."

glosses.meaning: who can discuss about the law or duty
in capturing the essence of scriptures
among all the celestials and demons (in these matters).

verses.devanagari:
शूरेण वीरेण निशाचरेन्द्र |
सुरासुराणामपि दुर्जयेन |
त्वया प्रगल्भाः सुरदैत्यसम्घा |
जिताश्च युद्धेष्वसकृन्नरेन्द्राः
verses.iast:
śūreṇa vīreṇa niśācarendra |
surāsurāṇāmapi durjayena |
tvayā pragalbhāḥ suradaityasamghā |
jitāśca yuddheṣvasakṛnnarendrāḥ
verses.translation: "O king of demons! You are valiant. You are heroic. Even celestials and demons cannot conquer you. You conquered a multitude of proud celestials and demons together with their kings in battles several times"

verses.devanagari:
न च अपि अस्य कपेः घाते कंचित् पश्यामि अहम् गुणम् |
तेष्व् अयम् पात्यताम् दण्डो यैः अयम् प्रेषितः कपिः
verses.iast:
na ca api asya kapeḥ ghāte kaṃcit paśyāmi aham guṇam |
teṣv ayam pātyatām daṇḍo yaiḥ ayam preṣitaḥ kapiḥ
verses.translation: "I do not see any merit in killing this monkey. Let this carnal punishment be employed on those by whom this monkey was sent."

verses.devanagari:
साधुः वा यदि वा असाधुः परैः एष समर्पितः |
ब्रुवन् पर अर्थम् परवान् न दूतो वधम् अर्हति
verses.iast:
sādhuḥ vā yadi vā asādhuḥ paraiḥ eṣa samarpitaḥ |
bruvan para artham paravān na dūto vadham arhati
verses.translation: "He is a person, sent by our enemies, whether he is good or bad. It is not worthy of killing him, who is an envoy, who is dependent on others and who talks for the cause of others."

verses.devanagari:
अपि च अस्मिन् हते राजन् न अन्यम् पश्यामि खे चरम् |
इह यः पुनः आगच्छेत् परम् पारम् महाउदधिः
verses.iast:
api ca asmin hate rājan na anyam paśyāmi khe caram |
iha yaḥ punaḥ āgacchet param pāram mahāudadhiḥ
verses.translation: "O king! Moreover, If he is killed, I do not find any other person, who can travel through the sky and come here again to this shore of the great ocean."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मान् न अस्य वधे यत्नः कार्यः पर पुरम् जय |
भवान् स इन्द्रेषु देवेषु यत्नम् आस्थातुम् अर्हति
verses.iast:
tasmān na asya vadhe yatnaḥ kāryaḥ para puram jaya |
bhavān sa indreṣu deveṣu yatnam āsthātum arhati
verses.translation: "O conqueror of enemies! Therefore, do not make efforts to kill him. On the other hand, you ought to strengthen such effort on celestials including indra."

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् विनष्टे न हि दूतम् अन्यम् |
पश्यामि यः तौ नर राज पुत्रौ |
युद्धाय युद्ध प्रिय दुर्विनीताव् |
उद्योजयेत् दीर्घ पथ अवरुद्धौ
verses.iast:
asmin vinaṣṭe na hi dūtam anyam |
paśyāmi yaḥ tau nara rāja putrau |
yuddhāya yuddha priya durvinītāv |
udyojayet dīrgha patha avaruddhau
verses.translation: "O Ravana, who is fond of war! If he is dead, I do not find any other hero, who can incite those two arrogant princes, who are hindered by a long distance, for war."

glosses.meaning: and who are hindered by a long distance

verses.devanagari:
पराक्रम उत्साह मनस्विनाम् च |
सुर असुराणाम् अपि दुर्जयेन |
त्वया मनो नन्दन नैरृतानाम् |
युद्ध आयतिः नाशयितुम् न युक्ता
verses.iast:
parākrama utsāha manasvinām ca |
sura asurāṇām api durjayena |
tvayā mano nandana nairṛtānām |
yuddha āyatiḥ nāśayitum na yuktā
verses.translation: "O Ravana who can gladden the hearts of demons! It is not proper for you, who are difficult to be conquered by even celestials and demons having sufficient prowess energy and courage, to crush the arrival of a war."

glosses.meaning: O Ravana who can gladden the hearts
who are difficult to be conquered

verses.devanagari:
हिताः च शूराः च समाहिताः च |
कुलेषु जाताः च महागुणेषु |
मनस्विनः शस्त्रभृताम् वरिष्ठाः |
कोटि अग्र शस्ते सुभृताः च योधाः
verses.iast:
hitāḥ ca śūrāḥ ca samāhitāḥ ca |
kuleṣu jātāḥ ca mahāguṇeṣu |
manasvinaḥ śastrabhṛtām variṣṭhāḥ |
koṭi agra śaste subhṛtāḥ ca yodhāḥ
verses.translation: "There are more than a crore of valiant warriors in your charge, well-maintained, who desire your welfare, quite devoted, having colossal merits, born in a good tribe, holding high spirits and excellent wielders of weapons."

verses.devanagari:
तत् एक देशेन बलस्य तावत् |
केचित् तव आदेश कृतो अपयान्तु |
तौ राज पुत्रौ विनिगृह्य मूढौ |
परेषु ते भावयितुम् प्रभावम्
verses.iast:
tat eka deśena balasya tāvat |
kecit tava ādeśa kṛto apayāntu |
tau rāja putrau vinigṛhya mūḍhau |
pareṣu te bhāvayitum prabhāvam
verses.translation: "Therefore, let some who follow your command, by talking a portion of your army, subjugate those two stupid princes, in order to make your power known to your adversaries."

verses.devanagari:
निशाचराणामधिपोऽनुजस्य |
विभीषणस्योत्तमवाक्यमिष्टम् |
जग्राह बुद्ध्या सुरलोकशत्रु |
र्महाबलो राक्षसराजमुख्यः
verses.iast:
niśācarāṇāmadhipo'nujasya |
vibhīṣaṇasyottamavākyamiṣṭam |
jagrāha buddhyā suralokaśatru |
rmahābalo rākṣasarājamukhyaḥ
verses.translation: Ravana, the mighty and the eminent king of demons as also the lord of ogres and the adversary of the world of celestials, understood the cherished and excellent message of Vibhishana his brother with his due presence of mind."

glosses.meaning: and the adversary of the world of celestials
